_comment: Typecheck project for test/ only. The base config excludes test/, so a signature change cannot break its tests — see scripts/check-test-signatures.ts. The test/ entries in `include` must list the same suffixes as TEST_EXTENSIONS in that script: a suffix missing from both is invisible to the gate rather than reported by it. web/src/__tests__ is excluded by its own config and keeps the same hole. The platform app UIs are separate packages, gated under their own configs by scripts/check-platform-apps.ts. Strictness the fixtures do not meet is relaxed here so the compiler still resolves every signature and every import; the gate fails on every diagnostic this project reports. Tightening an option relaxed here means fixing what it reports first.
